message.content: {"rules":["The closure registered with `before_exec` must perform only async-signal-safe operations when it runs in the child process after `fork` and before `exec`.","The caller of `before_exec` must ensure that the closure does not violate library invariants through invalid use of resources duplicated by `fork`, including file descriptors and memory-mapped regions.","Panicking in the closure registered with `before_exec` is safe only if all format arguments for the panic message can be safely formatted in the child process after `fork` and before `exec`; this condition applies even though `Command` calls `std::panic::always_abort` before invoking the closure."]}
